summary.name: WPS Office for Mac
summary.one_liner: WPS Office for Mac is an office suite for macOS that opens, edits, and shares Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files, built for Apple silicon.
use_cases: Editing Word documents on a Mac without Microsoft Office
Creating spreadsheets and presentations on macOS
Reading and editing PDFs in one app
Co-editing documents with a team and syncing across Mac, iPad, and iPhone
Generating slides or drafts with AI assistance
summary.what_it_does: The page describes WPS Office as a single workspace for Docs, Sheets, Slides, and PDFs. It says the suite is 100% compatible with Office formats and can open and save files without layout changes. It lists AI features for drafting, expanding topics, translating side by side, and turning topics into slides with speaker notes. It mentions auto-save and version history for reverting to earlier drafts, plus end-to-end encryption, real-time co-editing, and sync across Mac, iPad, and iPhone. It also offers a template library for resumes, papers, and reports.
notable: AI drafting, translation, and slide generation with speaker notes
Claims 100% compatibility with Office file formats
caveats: Page does not state which AI or premium features require payment
Platform list beyond macOS, iOS and iPad is inferred from sync claims only, not a full platform list
